title: 第二十五章第一个影卫第二十六章大国边事

紫徽湖的夕阳，美得令人心折。晚霞如血，泼洒西天，倒映在平静的湖面，水天一色，仿佛整个世界都被染上了一层瑰丽而凄艳的红。晚风拂过，湖面荡起细微的涟漪，将那一片血色揉碎，化作无数跳跃的光。
石桥蜿蜒，水榭临波。四位风度翩翩的公子，两位容貌如花的红颜，正漫步在这如画的景致之中。他们衣袂飘飘，谈笑晏晏，与周围的湖光山色融为一体，竟构成了另一道动人的风景，丝毫不逊色于那漫天晚霞。
紫徽湖的游人渐渐稀少，四周的喧嚣也悄然散去，只剩下风声与水波声交织，显得有些冷清。然而，在这略显寂寥的氛围中，却有一道不太协调的身影，始终不远不近地跟在秦枫等人身后。那是一位垂暮的老人。他衣衫陈旧，身形佝偻，步履也略显蹒跚。他始终与秦枫等人保持着大约十丈的距离，不远不近，不疾不徐。
秦枫等人早已察觉到了他的存在。秦翊的目光微微一凝，侧头看了一眼身旁的秦枫。秦枫心领神会，脚步不着痕迹地放慢了一些，与秦枫拉开了一点距离。片刻之后，秦枫停下脚步，转身对着那一直远远跟随的老人招了招手。老人看到招手，先是愣了一下，随即脸上露出一丝紧张和一丝不易察觉的惶恐。他犹豫了一瞬，最终还是深吸一口气，加快了脚步，快步朝着秦枫走来。他在秦枫一丈开外停下，显得有些拘谨。秦翊这时也转过身，缓步走了过来，站在秦枫身侧。秦枫目光平静地落在老人身上，嘴角带着一丝若有若无的笑意，开口道：“老人家，有事吗？”
老人看了秦枫一眼，声音有些干涩，带着一丝不易察觉的颤抖：“没……没事，有……有事”。他似乎有些紧张，连说话都变得结结巴巴起来，一时之间，竟不知该如何措辞。
秦枫并未在意，只是依旧保持着那温和的笑容，语气平和地说道：“说来听听。”老人这一次，目光不再躲闪，而是直直地看向秦枫，眼神中充满了急切与恳盼：“您……您是从仙宗来的吧？”
秦枫闻言，脸上的笑容微微一敛，却没有立刻回答，只是静静地看着他。
老人见状，脸上闪过一丝慌乱，但很快又镇定下来，继续说道：“我听说……听说真君带着少宗主在皇城。那么，少宗主就一定会来紫徽湖……我……我在这等了十天了。”他的声音不高，却带着一种近乎固执的坚持。
“我想……”老人深吸一口气，目光紧紧地盯着秦枫，一字一句地说道，“你一定是少宗主，或者……是少宗主身边的人。”说完这句话，他的身体微微有些颤抖，眼神中充满了期待，又带着一丝不安，仿佛在等待着命运的判决。
秦枫沉默了片刻，目光平静地与老人对视着，片刻之后，才缓缓开口，声音清晰而肯定：“对。”仅仅一个字，却仿佛给了老人无穷的力量。老人的眼睛瞬间亮了起来，原本有些佝偻的身躯似乎也挺直了几分，脸上露出了激动的神色，连声音都变得高亢了一些：“没事，我……我就想请少宗主……到家吃个饭。”
这个请求，有些突兀，却又带着一种质朴的真诚。
秦枫微微一怔，显然也有些意外。他看了老人一眼，目光在他那张布满皱纹、却写满了期待的脸上停留了片刻，随即若有所思地沉默了下来。他没有立刻答应，也没有拒绝，而是抬起头，目光看向身旁的秦翊，同时以神识与秦翊交流。片刻之后，秦翊点了点头，对着不远处的另外四人使了个眼色。那四人会意，也纷纷走了过来，围拢在一起。大家用神识交换了意见后。
“既然如此，”秦枫语气平和地说道，“那就叨扰了。”
老人闻言，脸上顿时露出了欣喜的表情，连连摆手：“不叨扰，不叨扰！能请少宗主到寒舍坐坐，是老朽的福气，是老朽的福气啊！”
他激动得有些语无伦次，连忙转身，对着不远处停着的一辆略显陈旧的马车招了招手。车夫似乎早就得到了吩咐，立刻赶着马车缓缓驶了过来。秦枫等人对视一眼，也不再犹豫，招来马车，跟随着老人的马车，离开了紫徽湖。
一柱香的时间，悄然流逝。原本还残留着一丝余晖的天色，此刻已经完全暗了下来，夜幕如同巨大的黑布，将整个世界笼罩。然而，对于秦枫这些修为不俗的修士来说，黑暗并没有带来太多的不便，他们的神识与灵觉足以让他们清晰地感知到周围的一切。马车在一座看起来颇为普通的小四合院门前停下。院子不大，院墙也有些斑驳，显然已经有些年头了。门口没有悬挂任何牌匾，显得十分低调。
秦枫等人陆续下了马车。秦枫站在门口，目光平静地扫视了一眼这座小院，以及周围的环境。他的神识悄然铺开，如同一张无形的大网，将整个小院笼罩其中。片刻之后，他收回了神识。这座小院布置得十分简单，并没有什么强大的禁制守护，只在院墙四周与门口布下了一些颇为基础的防护阵与预警阵。这些阵法等级不高，更多的是起到一些防窥与示警的作用，对于真正的高手来说，几乎形同虚设。
老人连忙上前，殷勤地说道：“少宗主，里面请，里面请！地方简陋，还望少宗主莫要嫌弃。”
秦枫微微颔首，迈步走进了院子。秦翊等人紧随其后。院子不大，却收拾得十分干净整洁。院中种着几株不知名的花草，虽然并不名贵，却也生机勃勃。正房的门敞开着，里面透出昏黄的灯光，给这略显清冷的小院增添了一丝暖意。就在这时，一个瘦弱的身影从屋内快步跑了出来。那是一个大约十岁左右的小女孩。她穿着一身发白的粗布衣裙，身形略显单薄，脸色也有些苍白。小女孩看到老人，脸上立刻绽放出灿烂的笑容，一边欢快地叫着“爷爷”，一边小跑着扑了过来，伸出双臂，紧紧地抱住了老人的胳膊。

“小雅乖。”老人立刻换上了一副慈祥的笑容，弯腰摸了摸小女孩的头，眼中充满了溺爱，随即侧身，将小女孩拉到身前，对着秦枫等人，柔声道，“快，叫少主，叫小姐。”
小女孩有些怯生生地抬起头，看了秦枫一眼，又迅速低下头，小声地喊道：“少主……小姐……”她的声音不大，却很清脆，带着一丝孩童特有的稚嫩。
秦枫看着眼前这个怯生生的小女孩，微微颔首，脸上露出一丝温和的笑容，算是回应。
“快进屋吧，饭菜还温着。”老人连忙招呼道，热情地将秦枫等人让进了屋内。屋内的陈设同样十分简单，一张老旧的木桌，几把木椅，墙角放着一些杂物，显得有些清贫。但桌椅都擦得干干净净，地面也打扫得一尘不染，看得出主人的用心。待六人在桌前坐定，老人摆上菜肴。虽然算不上什么山珍海味，却也颇为丰盛。中间是一大锅热气腾腾的鱼汤，汤色乳白，散发着浓郁的香味；旁边是一盘炒鸡肉，色泽金黄，香气扑鼻；还有几盘青翠的野菜，看起来十分清爽。总共八大碗菜，摆满了整张桌子。桌子中央，还放着一壶老酒，散发着淡淡的酒香。

The sunset at Zihui Lake is heart-breakingly beautiful. The sunset glow is like blood, splashing across the western sky and reflected on the calm lake. The water and sky are the same color, as if the whole world has been dyed with a layer of magnificent and sad red. The evening breeze blew by, causing subtle ripples on the lake surface, crushing the blood into countless dancing lights.
The stone bridges meander and the waterside pavilions touch the waves. Four handsome young men and two beauties with beautiful faces were strolling in this picturesque scenery. Their clothes were fluttering, they were chatting and laughing, blending in with the surrounding lakes and mountains, forming another moving scenery, no less than the sunset glow in the sky.
The number of tourists in Zihui Lake gradually became fewer and fewer, and the noise around it quietly dispersed, leaving only the sound of wind and water waves intertwined, making it seem a bit deserted. However, in this slightly lonely atmosphere, there was an uncoordinated figure, always following Qin Feng and others at a close distance. That was an old man who was dying. His clothes were old, his figure was stooped, and his steps were slightly staggering. He always kept a distance of about ten feet from Qin Feng and others, neither far nor close, neither fast nor slow.
Qin Feng and others had already noticed his presence. Qin Yi's eyes narrowed slightly and he glanced sideways at Qin Feng beside him. Qin Feng understood this and slowed down his steps without leaving a trace, putting a little distance between him and Qin Feng. After a moment, Qin Feng stopped, turned around and waved to the old man who had been following him from a distance. When the old man saw the wave, he was stunned for a moment, and then his face showed a trace of nervousness and a trace of imperceptible fear. He hesitated for a moment, and finally took a deep breath, quickened his pace, and walked quickly towards Qin Feng. He stopped a few feet away from Qin Feng, looking a little cautious. Qin Yi also turned around at this time, walked over slowly, and stood beside Qin Feng. Qin Feng's eyes fell on the old man calmly, with a faint smile on his lips, and he said, "Old man, is something wrong?"
The old man glanced at Qin Feng, and his voice was a little dry, with a subtle tremor: "No...it's okay, there is...something happened." He seemed a little nervous, even stammering when he spoke. For a moment, he didn't know how to express his words.
Qin Feng didn't pay attention, but still maintained his gentle smile, and said in a calm tone: "Tell me." This time, the old man no longer dodged his eyes, but looked straight at Qin Feng, his eyes full of eagerness and hope: "You... you are from the Immortal Sect, right?"
When Qin Feng heard this, the smile on his face faded slightly, but he did not answer immediately. He just looked at him quietly.
Seeing this, a trace of panic flashed across the old man's face, but he quickly calmed down and continued: "I heard...I heard that the true monarch is in the imperial city with the young sect master. Then the young sect master will definitely come to Zihui Lake...I...I have been waiting here for ten days." His voice was not high, but it carried an almost stubborn persistence.
"I think..." the old man took a deep breath, stared at Qin Feng closely, and said word by word, "You must be the Young Sect Master, or... someone close to the Young Sect Master." After saying this, his body trembled slightly, and his eyes were full of expectation and a little uneasy, as if he was waiting for the judgment of fate.
Qin Feng was silent for a moment, looking at the old man calmly. After a moment, he slowly spoke, his voice clear and affirmative: "Yes." It was just one word, but it seemed to give the old man infinite power. The old man's eyes lit up instantly, and his originally stooped body seemed to straighten up a bit. There was an excited look on his face, and his voice became louder: "It's okay, I... I just want to invite the young sect master... to have a meal at home."
This request was a bit abrupt, but it also carried a kind of simple sincerity.
Qin Feng was slightly startled, obviously a little surprised. He glanced at the old man, his eyes lingering on his wrinkled but expectant face for a moment, and then he fell silent thoughtfully.Come. He did not immediately agree or refuse, but raised his head and looked at Qin Yi beside him, while communicating with Qin Yi with his spiritual consciousness. After a moment, Qin Yi nodded and winked at the other four people not far away. The four people understood and came over one after another and gathered around them. After everyone exchanged opinions with their spiritual consciousness.
"In that case," Qin Feng said calmly, "then I'm sorry."
When the old man heard this, a happy expression suddenly appeared on his face, and he waved his hands repeatedly: "Don't bother me, don't bother me! It's my blessing to be able to invite the young sect master to sit in my humble abode! It's my blessing!"
He was so excited that he was a little incoherent. He quickly turned around and waved to a slightly old carriage parked not far away. The coachman seemed to have received the order a long time ago and immediately drove the carriage slowly over. Qin Feng and others looked at each other, no longer hesitated, summoned a carriage, and followed the old man's carriage out of Zihui Lake.
The time of a stick of incense passes quietly. The sky, which originally still had a trace of afterglow, was now completely dark, and the night was like a huge black cloth, covering the entire world. However, for monks like Qin Feng who have good cultivation, darkness does not bring much inconvenience. Their spiritual consciousness and spiritual sense are enough to allow them to clearly perceive everything around them. The carriage stopped in front of the door of a small courtyard that looked quite ordinary. The yard is not big, and the walls are a bit patchy, obviously they have been there for some time. There is no plaque hanging at the door, making it look very low-key.
Qin Feng and others got off the carriage one after another. Qin Feng stood at the door and glanced calmly at the small courtyard and the surrounding environment. His consciousness spread out quietly, like a large invisible net, covering the entire courtyard. After a moment, he withdrew his consciousness. The layout of this small courtyard is very simple, and there are no powerful restrictive guards. There are only some basic protective and early warning arrays set up around the courtyard walls and at the entrance. The level of these formations is not high, and they serve more of a purpose to prevent prying eyes and provide warnings. For real masters, they are almost useless.
The old man hurriedly stepped forward and said diligently: "Young Sect Master, please come inside, please come inside! The place is simple, I hope Young Sect Master will not dislike it."
Qin Feng nodded slightly and stepped into the courtyard. Qin Yi and others followed closely behind. The yard is not big, but it is kept very clean and tidy. There are several unknown flowers and plants planted in the courtyard. Although they are not expensive, they are full of vitality. The door of the main room was open, and dim light came from inside, adding a touch of warmth to the slightly cold courtyard. At this moment, a thin figure quickly ran out of the house. It was a little girl about ten years old. She was wearing a white coarse cloth dress, her figure was a little thin, and her face was a little pale. When the little girl saw the old man, a bright smile burst out on her face. She called "Grandpa" cheerfully, ran over to him, stretched out her arms, and hugged the old man's arm tightly.
"Xiao Ya is good." The old man immediately put on a kind smile, bent down and touched the little girl's head, his eyes full of doting, then turned sideways, pulled the little girl in front of him, and said softly to Qin Feng and others, "Quick, call me young master, call me miss."
The little girl raised her head timidly, glanced at Qin Feng, then quickly lowered her head and shouted in a low voice: "Young Master...Miss..." Her voice was not loud, but it was crisp, with a hint of childishness.
Qin Feng looked at the timid little girl in front of him, nodded slightly, and showed a gentle smile on his face as a response.
"Come in quickly, the food is still warm." The old man greeted quickly and enthusiastically let Qin Feng and others into the house. The furnishings in the house are also very simple, with an old wooden table, a few wooden chairs, and some sundries placed in the corner, making it look a bit poor. But the tables and chairs were wiped clean, and the floor was swept spotlessly.It shows the owner’s intentions. After the six people sat down at the table, the old man placed the dishes. Although it is not a delicacy, it is quite rich. In the middle is a large pot of steaming fish soup, which is milky white in color and exudes a rich aroma; next to it is a plate of fried chicken, golden in color and fragrant; and there are several plates of green wild vegetables, which look very refreshing. A total of eight large bowls of food filled the entire table. In the center of the table, there is a pot of old wine, exuding a faint aroma of wine.
